findings.requirements: Revision brief section 6 required the I2 comparator to return zero deltas.
findings.evidence: That criterion was wrong and is the orchestrator's defect, not the executor's. The retained I2 baseline predates Task 763's own accepted change, so comparing against it necessarily reproduces the 48 accepted A3 transition-property deltas and can never return zero. The executor ran the literal instruction, showed the result reproduces the identical 48-delta set, built the correct pre-rename versus post-rename comparator returning 0/2896, retained both transcripts, and flagged the discrepancy instead of substituting silently. Same class of orchestrator defect as Task 763 section 3.5 and Task 764 AC6: a criterion written against an assumed baseline rather than the state that exists.

check:design-tokens --strict stays at exit 1 with the same two AppImage.module.css literals (border-radius 3.40282e38px, transition-duration 300ms). Correct per the brief and Sprint 63 rule 2; it is an owner decision, not a defect, and it means the aggregate design-tokens gate is red for as long as D63-F is unresolved.

Two of the ten new names, .frameWidth and .frameClip, still lean on the CSS effect rather than the role. Both were suggested verbatim by the orchestrator in the revision brief section 5, so they cannot be raised against the executor; recorded so a future naming pass has the observation.
